ideal_profile_text:
- For Sales (Agency and Partnership Distribution) Divisions:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree holders with a minimum GPA of 7.0/10.
Candidates with less than 2 years of work experience.
Fluent in business-level English.
Strong sales acumen, excellent communication skills, customer-oriented mindset, willing to travel frequently for business requirements.

- For Non-sales Divisions:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree holders with a minimum GPA of 7.0/10.
Candidates with less than 1 year of work experience.
Fluent in business-level English.
Digitally savvy, customer-centric graduates with experience in social/community work or volunteer activities.


Ownership

Take ownership of problems and resolutions, execute with speed and perseverance.
Embrace challenges and stretch goals; takes bold steps to push beyond the status quo.
Step out of comfort zone and support the team through obstacles.
Make well-reasoned decisions promptly, considering potential risks.
Innovation

Develop innovative solutions to business challenges.
Embrace AI and digital tools to enhance how we work and serve customers.
Experiment, learn fast, and continuously get better.
Customer Centricity

Focus on customer-centric decisions and solutions.
Leverage technology to enhance experiences across touchpoints.
Commit to making things Stronger. Faster. Better.
